Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words. I’d be happy to help build the analytics dashboard. The scope you described (real-time charts, REST API integration, auth/role-based access, responsive + dark mode) is a good fit. Your budget of $5k–$6k and ~4 week timeline sounds reasonable; I’d like to confirm requirements and data access before finalizing an estimate.

I’m available for a 30-minute call next week to go over details — Tue/Wed/Thu between 10am–1pm CT or Fri 2–5pm CT. If any of those work, I’ll send a calendar invite. In the meantime, could you share API docs (or a sample endpoint), any existing UI mocks, and whether you prefer D3 or are open to Recharts/Chart.js? Also let me know required auth flows (SSO, JWT, etc.).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer, TechCorp Inc.
